svg.title: USB-only XIAO and FIT0774 breadboard wiring
svg.desc: USB powers XIAO. XIAO 3V3 goes to j18, GND to h2, D4 to i8. PN2222ABU E b7, B b8, C b9. 1k d8 to g8; 10k d14 to g14. Diode cathode g18 and anode g22. Motor positive h18, negative h22. Fixed jumpers a8-a14, c9-c22, e22-f22, a7-a2, e2-f2, j2-j14. Optional button D1 to GND at i2. No battery, bench supply or external capacitor.

g.text: Plain XIAO nRF52840 + FIT0774 + PN2222ABU · no battery · no added 104
Unplug USB before wiring. Use 3V3, not 5V. Remove the old i8–i18 ON jumper and all bench-supply leads.
Side power rails are not used.
E b7 · B b8 · C b9
BAND end g18 · plain end g22
Connect board D1 and hole i2 as shown.
Or use the existing USB commands: 1 / 2 / 3.
Only wire ends plug into holes. Insulated wire crossings do not join. Drawing paths are not required wire lengths.
Proposed shared-3V3 wiring. Actual combined startup load / driver behavior remain unknown. Motor firmware must use D4.
